name: explore
description: Search the TwexAPI REST catalog. Find tweet search, user lookup, followers, timelines, DMs, and write routes.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Optional search string over endpoint names, paths, and summaries.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Optional category such as search, users, tweets, followers, or dm.

arguments.name: include_writes
arguments.desc: Include routes with side effects. Default false.

name: twexapi_request
description: Call an allowlisted TwexAPI REST endpoint with a relative path such as /twitter/advanced_search/page.

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: HTTP method such as GET or POST.
